name: Automatic Package Installation
description: Automatically detects and runs npm/yarn/pnpm/nub install in non-interactive mode after container creation.

command.description: Installation command to use: 'install', 'ci' (npm ci/pnpm install --frozen-lockfile), or 'auto' to detect. Ignored when packageManager resolves to 'nub' — nub only has 'install'.

packageManager.description: Package manager to use. 'auto' detects based on lockfile (never resolves to 'nub' — that's an explicit opt-in, not auto-detected, since nub isn't itself a lockfile format). 'nub' runs 'nub install', which requires the nub feature also be installed with its default installGlobally:true (otherwise nub isn't on PATH here), and only understands npm/pnpm/bun lockfiles — not yarn.lock.

workingDirectory.description: Directory where to run the install command

skipIfNodeModulesExists.description: Skip installation if node_modules directory already exists

additionalArgs.description: Additional arguments to pass to the install command

directories.description: Comma-separated list of directories to run install in. Overrides workingDirectory and autoDiscover.

autoDiscover.description: Scan /workspaces for VS Code/Cursor (.code-workspace) and IntelliJ (.idea/modules.xml) project files and install packages in every discovered root that contains a package.json.
